entry.title: New: pty-runner
entry.summary: Long-lived background terminal jobs for dsh: launch processes in a PTY, write input (including control sequences like Ctrl+C), page through ring-buffered output, and stop jobs gracefully or forcefully. Exact install spec: github:johnxu22786/pty-runner. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
